title: The Traveler's Square
template:
Collecting stamps is a peaceful way to see the whole world from my desk. Today, I discovered a tiny envelope tucked inside an old book. It was sealed with a [color] ribbon and smelled like old parchment.

I carefully peeled it open to find a stamp showing a [land_feature] from a land called ZenoVibes. The tiny illustration featured a [creature] resting under a silver moon. It looked so realistic that I could almost hear the wind blowing through the scene.

I used my tweezers to gently place the treasure into my [container]. Looking at it made me feel very [emotion] as if I were about to go on an adventure. Every stamp in my book tells a story, but this one is the most magical of all.
